sign_clearance_margin_m.description: Extra margin (m) beyond the chassis and sign half-widths when passing a sign.

wall_clearance_margin_m.description: margin beyond chassis half-diagonal from a wall

activation_dist_m.description: Distance (m) at which a sign is engaged; must stay below passed_dist_m, which retires it on the same tick.

passed_dist_m.description: distance beyond which a sign is "passed"

deform_depth_buffer_m.description: Depth-axis slack (m) for the in-corridor test; too small disables avoidance at corner signs at grid depth 1.0/2.0.

detection_match_dist_m.description: max distance to associate a detection with a sign

min_confidence.description: minimum confidence to accept a camera color update

settle_ticks.description: ticks after lap start before bookkeeping activates

slot_sign_map.description: Assign sign evidence to the rulebook's 24 legal grid cells instead of clustering camera reports freely. ON; the simulator cannot screen it.

slot_accept_radius_m.description: How close (m) an observation must be to a legal sign-lattice cell to claim it.

slot_min_evidence.description: Summed detection confidence a lattice cell needs before it may hold a sign slot.

slot_repoint_margin.description: Factor by which a challenger cell must out-weigh the incumbent cell to take its sign slot.

slot_exclusive_adjacent_depths.description: A section may not hold beliefs at ADJACENT depth lines (0.5 m apart): the WRO table never pairs depth 1.5 with 1.0 or 2.0, so such a pair is one pillar whose reading straddles the midpoint between two rows. The adjacent cell is treated like the other lateral of the same depth: heaviest wins, re-pointed without the hysteresis margin. Depths 1.0 and 2.0 stay two pillars.

escape_mask_radius_m.description: How close (m) a LIDAR return must land to a routed sign to be attributed to it and withheld from the reactive escape trigger; 0 disables the mask.

escape_mask_cluster_assoc_m.description: Snap the escape mask onto the LIDAR cluster nearest the believed sign; 0.0 disables the snap.

escape_mask_chassis_margin_m.description: Tolerance (m) on the nominal chassis rectangle when the robot's own returns are rejected per bearing; no range floor.

commit_hysteresis.description: Hold the committed sign until it is cleared rather than re-running the nearest-wins race every tick.

corridor_flip_ticks.description: Consecutive ticks the robot's corridor must agree before the label commits; 1 leaves the mechanism inert.

sign_aware_speed.description: Cap speed at the slow tier while the router holds a sign deformation this tick; Obstacles-only.

sign_commit_fit_speed.description: Cap speed so the chassis turn radius (R = intercept + slope * v, a speed curve on this chassis) can buy the lateral the committed pass still needs within the run-up the commit actually left: a single arc buys s^2/(2R) over s metres, so the fitting speed is v = (s^2 / (2 * lateral) - intercept) / slope, with s the nose-to-pillar distance and lateral = (chassis half-diagonal + sign half-width) - the offset already held on the legal side. Acts only while that lateral is positive and the pillar is ahead; the lane's own steering is untouched. Obstacles-only by construction (needs a committed sign).

sign_commit_fit_floor_mps.description: Lowest speed sign_commit_fit_speed may command, in m/s. Below ~0.06 m/s the fit is asking for a radius the chassis cannot deliver at all, and a crawl that slow costs the round clock more than it buys.

sign_lane_offset_frac.description: Fraction of the full lane offset actually applied.

sign_lane_ramp_m.description: Metres over which the lane offset ramps in, and is then held.

sign_lane_hold_m.description: Half-width (m) of the full-offset plateau around each routed sign.

sign_lane_gap_centre_frac.description: How far a squeezed plateau moves from the clamped limit toward the midpoint of its free gap; 0.0 clamped, 1.0 full centring.

sign_lane_commit_ahead_m.description: Commit the lane this far ahead of the sign; 0 = at the sign.

sign_lane_corner_entry_m.description: Distance from a corner at which lane entry is suppressed.

sign_lane_suppress_deform.description: Suppress the older per-waypoint deformation while the lane planner drives.

sign_lane_deform_fallback_m.description: Use the router's deform where the lane has not taken the target this far (m) onto the legal side; it replaces, never adds to, the lane.

sign_deform_sense_guard.description: Drop the deform when it pushes the aim point against the path's direction of travel; inert while the lane suppresses the deform.

sign_lane_relabel_unsatisfiable.description: Re-label a lane that cannot be satisfied rather than skipping it outright.

sign_lane_skip_unsatisfiable.description: Drop a sign from the lane profile when its own clamped target lands on the forbidden side of it.

sign_lane_depth_consistent_corridor.description: Require the corridor's depth reading to agree before committing a lane.

sign_lane_split_overlap.description: Allow two lanes to overlap. REFUTED -- kept off.

pin_corner_guard.description: Re-check that the robot's real position is squarely in the corridor before the depth pin holds the point abeam a sign.

pin_heading_guard.description: Release the depth pin once the robot's heading has drifted more than pin_heading_guard_deg from where the pin engaged.

pin_heading_guard_deg.description: Heading disagreement, in degrees, above which the pin is refused.

sign_deform_speed_threshold_m.description: Deformation and speed coupling Minimum deformation, in metres, that counts as the router having moved the path -- what sign_aware_speed above gates on.

explore_lap_speed_frac.description: Speed fraction during the exploratory first lap. 1.0 = no reduction.

retrace_escape.description: Retrace the pose trail on escape. REFUTED; ships off.

retrace_dist_m.description: How far back along the pose trail the REFUTED retrace-on-escape aims (m).

retrace_steer_gain_deg.description: Road-wheel angle (degrees) commanded by the REFUTED retrace-on-escape when the target sits 45 degrees off the chassis.

sign_contact_evade.description: Evade a sign on contact rather than routing around it in advance.

sign_contact_dist_m.description: Along-track distance (m) within which a routed sign predicted to clip the chassis triggers the OFF sign-contact evade.

sign_contact_steer_deg.description: Road-wheel angle (degrees) steered away from the offending sign by the OFF sign-contact evade.

sign_aware_lookahead.description: Use the short pursuit lookahead while a routed sign is engaged.

sign_lidar_align.description: Steer toward a narrow LIDAR object ahead the camera has not classified; suppressed once a sign is committed. SHIPS OFF; refuted.

stale_target_rescue.description: Rescue a target that has gone stale mid-approach.

sign_lidar_align_min_m.description: Proximity window a LIDAR pillar return must fall inside to count as that sign's return, and the FOV cone around the camera bearing it must sit in.

sign_lidar_align_max_m.description: Far edge of the range window (m) a LIDAR pillar return must fall inside to count as a sign's return.

sign_lidar_align_fov_deg.description: Half-angle of the forward cone (degrees) searched for an unclassified LIDAR pillar return.

sign_lidar_align_depth_m.description: Reached depth (m) past a pulled line at which the align branch hands over a detected but unclassified return.

sign_lidar_align_max_width_m.description: Maximum arc width (m, nearest range times angular span) a LIDAR return may span and still read as pillar-shaped.

sign_lidar_align_deadband_deg.description: Heading deadband (degrees) of the steer-at-the-return law; do not raise while it ships off.

sign_lidar_align_gain.description: Heading gain of the steer-at-the-return law: the nudge is the return bearing scaled by this and clipped to sign_lidar_align_max_steer.

sign_lidar_align_max_steer.description: Cap on the normalized steering nudge (fraction of full lock) the unclassified-return align law may add.

sign_lidar_propose.description: Hand LIDAR-resolved pillars to discovery as sign candidates, in place of the camera's boxes. Ships off while discovery's own camera pipeline is trusted.

pair_handoff_span_m.description: Metres of travel past the committed sign over which the lateral target is interpolated to the next sign's line; 0 steps in one tick.
